components: 2 Double-sided Game Boards (Villa A1/A2, Hotel B1/B2)

setup.title: Family game
setup.detail: Roll and resolve three Explosions without placing any Damage Markers, then roll and place three starting POI.

setup.title: Experienced game: first Explosion
setup.detail: Roll and resolve an Explosion in the Target space; the initial Explosions should leave at least one Explosion on each level of the house.

rules: Each building has two floors on separate boards: Villa A1/A2, Hotel B1/B2.
Victims, Hazmats, etc can not be thrown from the second floor.
Upper and Lower Staircase spaces are Adjacent; Firefighters and Fire move between them at normal movement cost.
